dziennik.opis: When something does not work, the easiest way is Settings > Help and diagnostics > Report a problem. A diagnostic report helps when the treadmill does not connect.
dziennik.raport_trwa: Collecting the report, this takes about 30 s…
dziennik.raport_gotowy: Report saved. It is attached to your next problem report automatically.
dziennik.raport_blad: Could not collect the report. Check that Bluetooth is on.
dziennik.raport_brak_biezni: The report did not find the treadmill. Turn it on and close its phone app.
dziennik.pusty: The log is empty. Entries appear here when something happens.
dziennik.skopiowano: Log copied. You can paste it into a message.
dziennik.kopiuj_blad: Could not copy the log. Select the entries with the mouse and press Ctrl+C.
